mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit (name, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO user_habit (member_id, habit_id, status, color, frequency, start_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{habitId}, #{status.value}, #{color}, #{frequency}, #{startDate}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_habit_schedule (user_habit_id, day_of_week, times_per_week, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userHabitId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timesPerWeek}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO habit_category (habit_id, category_id, created_at) VALUES (#{habitId}, #{categoryId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT uh.id, h.name, uh.color, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, uh.frequency, uh.status, uh.frozen_until, uhs.day_of_week FROM user_habit uh JOIN habit h ON uh.habit_id = h.id LEFT JOIN habit_category hc ON h.id = hc.habit_id LEFT JOIN category c ON hc.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user_habit_schedule uhs ON uh.id = uhs.user_habit_id WHERE uh.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY uh.id DESC, uhs.day_of_week ASC

SELECT uh.id, h.name, uh.color, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, uh.frequency, uh.status, uh.frozen_until, uhs.day_of_week FROM user_habit uh JOIN habit h ON uh.habit_id = h.id LEFT JOIN habit_category hc ON h.id = hc.habit_id LEFT JOIN category c ON hc.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user_habit_schedule uhs ON uh.id = uhs.user_habit_id WHERE uh.id = #{userHabitId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit_history (user_habit_id, check_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userHabitId}, #{checkDate}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM habit_history WHERE user_habit_id = #{userHabitId} AND check_date = #{checkDate}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_habit_id, check_date, status, created_at FROM habit_history WHERE user_habit_id = #{userHabitId} AND check_date = #{checkDate}
SELECT id, member_id, habit_id, status, frozen_until, frequency, start_date, created_at, updated_at FROM user_habit WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_habit SET status = #{status.value}, frozen_until = #{frozenUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE habit SET name = #{name}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_habit SET color = #{color}, frequency = #{frequency}, start_date = #{startDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT habit_id FROM user_habit WHERE id = #{userHabitId}
